question.text: What additional requirements must a broker fulfill to offer algorithmic trading in ETIRD?

answer.text: Prior permission of the stock exchange, adequate risk controls, six-monthly system audits, and higher BMC/additional deposit requirements
No additional requirements beyond basic membership
Only a written request to the exchange is sufficient
Algorithmic trading requires a separate license from the Ministry of Finance

explanation.text: The Logic: Per NISM Series IV (pp.199, 290), a broker offering algorithmic trading must obtain prior permission of the stock exchange, maintain adequate risk-management controls, undergo six-monthly system audits, and meet higher Base Minimum Capital / additional-deposit requirements applicable to algo brokers. The Trap: Approval is required from the stock exchange, not directly from SEBI. A simple verbal/written request is insufficient, and no separate Ministry of Finance license is involved. Note: Risk controls typically include order-level checks and kill-switch arrangements; ongoing compliance with SEBI/exchange algo-trading guidelines is mandatory.
